I make snowmen with friends,
Wear warm coats and gloves.
Then spring comes again.

name: Little Duck is watching the sun go down
text:
Little Duck is watching the sun
go down. It is getting lower and
lower, but his shadow is getting
longer and longer.
"Why is that?" Little Duck asks
his friend Old Tree. "You are
older and smarter than me. Tell
me — why is my shadow longer
when the sun gets lower?"
Old Tree says,
"That’s easy, Little
Duck. The sun goes
down every day, and
we grow older every
day. Your shadow
grows longer because
you are growing taller.
You are becoming a big
beautiful bird!"
Can you answer Little
Duck’s question, Robin?
zh:
小鸭子看着太阳下山。太阳越来越低，但他的影子却越来越长。
“为什么呀？”小鸭子问他的朋友老树。“你比我年纪大，也比我聪明。告诉我——为什么太阳越低，我的影子就越长？”
老树说：“这很简单，小鸭子。太阳每天下山，我们每天变老。你的影子变长是因为你在长高。你正在变成一只又大又漂亮的鸟！”
你能回答小鸭子的这个问题吗，罗宾？

name: Wu Binbin's diary
text:
Saturday, April 23rd
Today was a sunny day. In the morning, we rode a bike for three people. Max sat in a basket on the front of the bike.
That was fun! We took pictures of the beautiful countryside.
We bought some gifts and ate some delicious food.
In the afternoon, Mum ate some bad fruit and didn’t feel well. So we stayed in the hotel. Dad and I wanted to make her happy. We dressed up and made a funny play. Robin played the part of a dog. He was so cute. Max liked him so much. He jumped on him and licked him. Of course, Robin didn’t like it.
We laughed and laughed.
It was a bad day but also a good day!
zh:
4月23日，星期六
今天是晴天。早上，我们骑了一辆三人自行车。马克斯坐在自行车前面的篮子里。
那很有趣！我们拍了美丽乡村的照片。
我们买了一些礼物，吃了一些美味的食物。
下午，妈妈吃了一些坏水果，感觉不舒服。所以我们待在酒店里。爸爸和我想让她开心。我们穿上戏服，演了一出有趣的戏。罗宾扮演了一只狗。他太可爱了。马克斯非常喜欢他。他跳到他身上舔他。当然，罗宾不喜欢这样。
我们笑个不停。
这是糟糕的一天，但也是美好的一天！

name: What a dream!
text:
Wu Binbin had a race with his father and Max. There were many people there. His father ran very fast, but Wu Binbin could not.
There was nothing he could do. He was so worried. "I could run fast at school," he thought. "Why am I so slow now?"
Then Robin said, "Drink this!" and gave Wu Binbin some water. Wu Binbin drank it and suddenly he felt good. He could run fast again.
There was a second race. There were many animals in that race.
Wu Binbin ran like a cheetah. He could win the race! But suddenly he tripped and fell. Then he woke up. He was in bed. It was all a dream!

It is time to leave our school. We are all going to middle school soon, so we will say goodbye to each other. We are going to have a farewell party. You can bring your friends.
Place: Our music room     Time: Friday  3 p.m.
Activities:
We will draw pictures and sing songs. We are going to give prizes for the best pictures. We are going to have cake, candy and juice, too. Yum!
We will also give many prizes to our good students. For example, who helped others the most? Who studied hard? Who wrote the best story?
We will listen to music, play games and dance. It will be great fun.
See you at the party!

Miss White listened carefully and told Liu Jia, "Think about happy things. Call your friend or send her some emails."

"I will try. Thank you, Miss White," said Liu Jia.

Liu Jia

name: In space
text:
Chinese astronauts are called taikonauts. Their life in space is special.
The taikonauts get up early in the morning. But getting ready in space is different. They can't use water to wash their faces. So taikonauts have to use a wet cloth. They brush their teeth with a special toothpaste and have to "eat" it!
Each day the taikonauts are very busy. They do a lot of work. For example, they grow vegetables and rice. Sometimes, they also give classes to children and answer questions about space.
It is hard work. The taikonauts must stay healthy. Every afternoon they do exercise to keep healthy and strong. But their job is also very interesting. They can see the sunrise and sunset 16 times a day. The view is amazing! There is no other job like this one.
zh:
中国航天员被称为“太空人”。他们在太空中的生活很特别。
太空人早上很早起床。但在太空中做准备是不同的。他们不能用水洗脸，所以太空人必须用湿布。他们用一种特殊的牙膏刷牙，而且必须把牙膏“吃”掉！
太空人每天都很忙。他们做很多工作。例如，他们种植蔬菜和稻米。有时，他们还会给孩子们上课，并回答关于太空的问题。
这是一项艰苦的工作。太空人必须保持健康。每天下午他们都做运动以保持健康和强壮。但他们的工作也非常有趣。他们一天可以看到16次日出和日落。景色令人惊叹！没有别的工作像这样。

Dear students,

eat healthy food and drink enough water.

You can always talk to your parents, and you can ask me for help
too.
Yours,
Miss White

如果你有任何问题，别担心。每个人都有问题。你总是可以和父母谈谈，也可以向我求助。
你的，
怀特老师

Spring is green.
It's full of life.
I take many walks,
And fly my kite.
Summer is blue.
I play games and sing songs,
Wear dresses and T-shirts.
The days are so long.
Autumn is orange.

我喜欢落叶。

冬天是白色的。
我和朋友堆雪人，
穿暖和的外套和手套。
然后春天又来了。

My name is Robinson. I live on an island. I always get up early every day. I wash my face, and then I eat breakfast. Sometimes I clean my cave, too.

name: Green Energy
text:
Green Energy
What green energy do you know?
Wind power, solar power and water power are types of green energy.
How do we use it?
We use green energy to light, heat and cool our homes and schools.
We also use it to run cars, buses and trains.
Many resources will run out. How can we save energy?
We should follow the "3R" rules. We can reduce energy use, reuse things, and recycle old clothes, toys and books.
zh:
绿色能源
你知道哪些绿色能源？
风能、太阳能和水能都是绿色能源的类型。
我们如何使用它？
我们用绿色能源来照明、取暖和冷却我们的家与学校。
我们也用它来驱动汽车、公交车和火车。
许多资源将会耗尽。我们如何节约能源？
我们应该遵循“3R”规则。我们可以减少能源使用、重复利用物品，并回收旧衣服、玩具和书籍。
